{{Vanilla}}

{{Infobox auto}}

'''Dried kelp''' is the simple preparation of kelp, whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Water Breathing}}. It heals {{Value|Dried Kelp|heals}}, grants Water Breathing for {{Value|Dried Kelp|duration|effect=Water Breathing}} and is eaten in half a second.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/dried_kelp.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Kelp dries in an [[oven]] in {{Value|Dried Kelp|cook_time}}; there is no kindling recipe and the vanilla recipes are removed. A dried kelp block crafts back into 9 dried kelp with the same properties.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating dried kelp takes {{Value|Dried Kelp|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Dried Kelp|heals}} and gives Water Breathing for {{Value|Dried Kelp|duration|effect=Water Breathing|format=clock}}, which the tooltip calls "Gills".

Obtaining dried kelp unlocks [[gimmari]]. It is also used in [[lumpia]], [[bokguk]], [[Ramen Stock|ramen stock]] and [[seitan]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
